Jazz Oral History Project
Interview with Benjamin "Reb" Spikes
Conducted by Patricia Willard
Cassette 3

You found this listing in your file of some of your brother's inventions, and it has listed here: R.B. Spikes Patent No. 1,595,057 on June 29, 1926 it was registered, and that was the combination milk bottle opener and cover. Then he registered the method and apparatus for obtaining average samples and temperatures of tank liquids on October 27, 1931, Patent No. 1,328,753, and that's one you said was sold to Shell Oil Co. for testing [..........]
[..........] the way I understand it, yeah.

And...uh, then, automatic gearshift was invented by R.B. Spikes, registered December 8, 1932, Patent No. 1,889,814, and the transmission and shifting means therefore, registered November 28, 1933, Patent No. 1,936,996. And this is just a few of his inventions. That's marvelous.
